options.title: Toyota Kept Losing Its Best Customers to Mercedes
options.first_line: Toyota's best customers kept trading up to Mercedes, so in 1984 Toyota started a secret car.
options.first_frame: A silver Mercedes star badge fills the frame, then whips to a Toyota badge as a date stamp slams 1984.

options.title: Lexus Started as Toyota's Secret Project
options.first_line: Lexus began as a secret project inside Toyota, built to stop its richest buyers leaving.
options.first_frame: The Lexus badge on a car's grille pushes in close, with a label reading 'Lexus: made by Toyota'.

options.title: Toyota vs Mercedes: The Car Built to Steal Its Buyers
options.first_line: Toyota could sell a car to anyone, except the people who bought a Mercedes.
options.first_frame: A split screen: a Toyota on the left, a Mercedes on the right, the Mercedes side lighting up as the line ends.

why: C names two brands everyone knows and poses a paradox (Toyota sells to anyone but Mercedes buyers) that makes you stay to learn how it was solved, while B gives away that Lexus is Toyota in the title and A leans on a secret-car tease.
